originalTitle: Is the Kennedy Center losing 'hundreds of millions of dollars'?
summary: Records in 2024 show the venue had a surplus of millions of dollars once contributions and grants had been factored in.
content:
US President Donald Trump has claimed the Kennedy Center in Washington DC has been losing "tens of millions of dollars, even hundreds of millions of dollars" for years.

Trump, who wants his name on the famous performing arts venue, was photographed onboard Air Force One looking at a poster with a headline that appeared to tout the demolition of the site.

Federal audit records for 2024 show that, despite having "an operating deficit", it had a surplus of millions of dollars - as Aisha Sembhi explains.

Design by Mesut Ersöz and Henry Esterson. Additional reporting by Tom Edgington.
chineseTitle: 肯尼迪中心是否损失了“数亿美元”？
chineseSummary: 2024 年的记录显示，如果算上捐款和赠款，该场馆还有数百万美元的盈余。
chineseContent:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普声称，华盛顿特区的肯尼迪中心多年来一直损失“数千万美元，甚至数亿美元”。

特朗普希望自己的名字出现在这个著名的表演艺术场地上，他被拍到在空军一号上看着一张海报，海报的标题似乎是在宣传拆除该场地。

正如 Ais​​ha Sembhi 解释的那样，2024 年的联邦审计记录显示，尽管存在“运营赤字”，但仍有数百万美元的盈余。

由 Mesut Ersöz 和 Henry Esterson 设计。汤姆·埃丁顿的补充报道。
